title: Migrate dvb_t2_awgn_campaign binary to gf2-sim pipeline
description:
## Goal

Migrate `crates/gf2-coding/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs` from
`SimulationRunner::run_with_decoder` to the new `gf2-sim` hybrid
pipeline. Preserve all existing CLI flags; wire `--gpu` to the
HIP-backed path that Phase B + Phase C produce; verify the migration
delivers a measured speedup over the legacy path.

## Context

Task under story `5d0a3fad` (DVB-T2 BICM application) within epic
`gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §12 (migration plan,
explicit table of public APIs that move vs stay). Wave D.2: depends
on `8c8302c8`. Once this task lands, the cross-epic dependent
`e4849f07` (`epic:dvb-t2-awgn-campaign`) is unblocked for its
multi-day production sweep.

**Criterion amended 2026-06-07 (user-approved post-audit)**: the
original `parallelism-pays` criterion was a wall-clock budget
("≤ 24h/config on the existing PLAN.md bracket") that did not fit
the `parallelism-pays` receipt schema and was data-inconsistent
with the measured single-thread throughput on the SumProduct +
ExactLogMap configuration the README.md gap-closure plan requires.
The amended criterion is a speedup-vs-legacy figure: the new
pipeline must measurably outperform the legacy `simulation.rs`
path on the same MODCOD and decoder/demap pair. The full
production sweep wall-clock remains `e4849f07`'s scope.

**Byte-identity criterion further amended 2026-06-07 per Q2
(user-approved)**: byte-identity is between two new-pipeline runs
at the same seed, NOT vs the legacy path. The new pipeline's
ChaCha20 seek scheme (`ec530af9` §3) diverges from the legacy
`seed = base ^ rotate_left(snr_index, 13)` derivation in
`simulation.rs:431`. The legacy compat shim is not provided.

**AMENDMENT 2026-06-09 (user-approved scope correction — rigor MOVED
here, not weakened).** The `--strict-gpu` CLI flag (previously only a
deliverable here, and loosely referenced as a forward clause on B.3
`ed575f15` / C.2 `42eac5cc`) is promoted to a `[hard]` success
criterion ON THIS TASK — D.2 owns the CLI surface of the gf2-sim
campaign binary. (`PipelineConfig::strict_gpu` field is delivered by
`ed575f15`; the executor's honoring of it by `42eac5cc`; this task
exposes the `--strict-gpu` CLI flag that sets it.) PRE-DISPATCH VERIFY:
deliverable-1 names `Pipeline::run_with_decoder(...)` and the builder
`.with_gpu(true)`; these are the gf2-sim public RUN + GPU-enable
surface that PHASE C (`9e853c62` — scheduler/executor) must expose. If
Phase C lands a different public run entrypoint (e.g.
`run_sweep_checkpointed` / `parallel::run_snr_point*`) or a different
GPU-enable setter, update these deliverable names to the real surface
at dispatch — do not assume `Pipeline::run_with_decoder`/`with_gpu`
exist verbatim.

## Deliverables

1. Migration in `crates/gf2-coding/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs`:
   - Replace the `SimulationRunner::run_with_decoder(...)` call site
     (currently `simulation.rs:3828` via `runner.rs:971` invocation)
     with the gf2-sim public run entrypoint constructed via the
     typestate preset from `8c8302c8`. (Verify the exact entrypoint
     name against the Phase C public surface — see the 2026-06-09
     amendment note.)
   - Preserve all existing CLI flags: `--rate`, `--modulation`,
     `--esn0-range`, `--target-errors`, `--max-frames`, `--seed`,
     `--output-dir`, `--resume`, `--calibrate`,
     `--calibrate-frames`, `--calibrate-bracket`, `--decoder`,
     `--demap`.
   - Wire `--gpu` to the HIP-backed path: when set, the typestate
     builder enables the GPU path. Without `--features hip`,
     `--gpu` is a clear "GPU not compiled in" error.
2. `--strict-gpu` flag exposed on the migrated campaign binary, wired
   to `PipelineConfig::strict_gpu`, for reproducibility-critical runs.
   (The executor's response to the field — promote OOM→FatalError — is
   `42eac5cc`'s.)
3. Legacy path retained: `simulation.rs::SimulationRunner` and
   `runner.rs` are not deleted. The campaign binary path is the
   migration site; other callers in `gf2-coding` continue to use
   the legacy API until a follow-up epic deprecates it.
4. Parallelism-pays receipt: append an entry to
   `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/parallelism-receipts.md`:
   - Configuration: r1/2 16-QAM, `--decoder sumproduct
     --demap exactlogmap --seed 42`, 200 frames at Es/N0 = 6.25 dB
     (matching the audit's measured baseline of 1.62 fps).
   - Report new-pipeline frames/sec vs legacy single-thread baseline
     (from `c0b1702d`).
   - Threshold: new-pipeline frames/sec ≥ 8× the legacy single-thread
     baseline on the same configuration.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Campaign binary runs end-to-end via the `gf2-sim` pipeline;
  all existing CLI flags pass through.
- [hard] Within-new-pipeline byte-identity: two runs of the
  migrated binary at the same seed and same config produce
  byte-identical `fer / frames / errors / mean_iters` on the
  CPU-only path (the four deterministic columns). The legacy
  `simulation.rs` path is NOT a byte-identity comparison target
  per `ec530af9` §3 and §12 (user-approved Q2 on 2026-06-07).
- [hard] `--gpu` flag wires to the HIP path on `--features hip`
  builds; emits a clear error on default builds.
- [hard] `--strict-gpu` CLI flag exposed on the migrated campaign
  binary and wired to `PipelineConfig::strict_gpu` (verified by a
  CLI→config parse test); the executor's honoring of the field is
  `42eac5cc`'s. (Promoted to `[hard]` per the 2026-06-09 amendment —
  the CLI rigor moved here from `ed575f15`'s deliverable, not dropped.)
- [hard] `parallelism-pays` gate: receipt records new-pipeline
  end-to-end frames/sec ≥ 8× the legacy single-thread baseline
  from `c0b1702d` on the canonical configuration (r1/2 16-QAM,
  SumProduct, ExactLogMap, Es/N0 = 6.25 dB, seed 42).
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `parallelism-pays` gates green.

## Non-goals

- The multi-day production sweep over the PLAN.md brackets to
  closure (`≤ 0.5 dB gap`, `≥ 100 errors` at every bracket point)
  is `e4849f07`'s scope, not this task. This task only verifies
  the binary works and is measurably faster than the legacy path.
- Deletion of the legacy `SimulationRunner` path (out of epic
  scope).
- Byte-identity vs the legacy `simulation.rs` path (intentionally
  dropped per Q2 on 2026-06-07).
